title: Native connection with Fabric in Business Central
summary: Business Central introduces native integration with Microsoft Fabric for data synchronization, replacing the need for APIs or bc2adls tools. The sync operates directly from the SQL database using change logs, supporting all tables with minute-level latency and no impact on Business Central performance.
key_points: Native Fabric integration is built on Open Mirroring and syncs from the SQL change log instead of APIs or bc2adls
The sync has no NST impact, sends only committed records, supports deletions and arrives within minutes
Setup is done in Business Central (workspace, companies, tables) and can be fully managed through APIs
The BC environment and the Fabric workspace must be in the same tenant; a Fabric SKU is needed (F2 is usually enough), and the limit is 500 tables
bc2adls moves to maintenance mode (until about BC30 or BC31), and BC29 users are advised to test and migrate gradually

quotes.text: No API calls or endpoints needed. No bc2adls is needed. No impact on the NST.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core advantages: simplified architecture without external tools and no performance degradation
